sharedPost.text:
Your patient communication shouldn’t stop at making a call. It should be connected to the complete patient record.

With eCloudsHealth, healthcare teams can make and receive calls directly from Salesforce patient records, creating a more efficient way to manage communication and follow-ups.

By integrating phone workflows into the patient record, teams can:
✓ Call patients directly with one click
 ✓ Improve connection rates with expected caller ID
 ✓ Record conversations for better documentation
 ✓ Add follow-up notes easily
 ✓ Track call performance through real-time dashboards

When communication, documentation, and insights come together in one platform, teams can spend less time managing processes and more time supporting patients.

Learn how eCloudsHealth connects healthcare workflows:
 https://ecloudshealth.com/

#HealthcareTechnology #SalesforceHealthcare #PatientEngagement #HealthcareAutomation #HealthIT #DigitalHealth #HealthcareInnovation #HealthcareOperations

sharedPost.text:
Quick question… are your providers fully licensed, but actually struggling to get paid? 📉. Being licensed doesn’t automatically mean you’re enrolled with the payors you need. If payer enrollment isn't handled correctly right from the start, even fully credentialed providers will face major cash flow delays. At Complere Credentialing, we help healthcare organizations nationwide streamline provider enrollment, facility payer enrollment, and full revenue cycle management (RCM). Don’t let back-office bottlenecks hold your revenue back. 📲 Need help with payer enrollment? Let Complere help.
📞 386-267-1772
📧 info@complerecredentialing.com
🌐 www.complerecredentialing.com #ComplereCredentialing #ProviderEnrollment #FacilityEnrollment #RCM #MedicalCredentialing

items.text:
📢 Looking for a USA-Based Behavioral Health Business Consultant
I’m looking to connect with a USA-based consultant who has experience helping newly graduated behavioral health providers set up their businesses and launch their practices.

The idea is to conduct live Zoom sessions covering business setup, credentialing, billing, compliance, and the operational side of running a behavioral health practice.

If you have experience in this area and would be interested in teaching or collaborating on this project, please comment below or DM me.

Looking forward to connecting with the right person.

items.text:
Hello Everyone,
I am facing an issue from long time with Medicaid-IL. I am using Officeally for claim submission. But when I am submitting claims to Medicaid-IL as Secondary those are getting denied for Remark Code (MA92), As per Medicaid they are saying it's denied for Missing TPL Code in the claim form which can be entered in Loop Segment 2330B. And I also called Officeally for this but they don't have any idea about this. 

Please help me to fix this issue. Thank you

topComments.text: For Medicaid-IL secondary claims, make sure the TPL Source Code and TPL Status Code are correctly reported in Loop 2330B (REF*2U). Verify the patient’s TPL information for the specific DOS and enter the correct codes in Office Ally. If Office Ally cannot transmit these fields, contact them for an Illinois Medicaid-specific 837P setup or submit a paper claim if permitted.

Office Ally may not be programmed to send secondary Medicaid claims. CollaborateMD did not have this functionality when I was with them and had to generate paper secondary claims. I had to request special programming for OpenPM in order to get secondary Medicaid claims to generate correctly. There are four fields that need to be valued in addition to the TPL code. You also need the status code, the date the primary claim paid and the amount paid. TPL codes are only three digits in Illinois.
